Ask Papa K's

Daily Specials

Add one or more specials per day with a description and price. The top banner shows whatever is set for today, rotating through multiple specials automatically, each with its own price called out. Saved on this device/browser.
Edit menu items & prices
Turn this on to click into any name, description, or price on the site and type over it — including adding or removing items. Changes save automatically to this device/browser.

Holiday Theme

Adds festive floating decorations and a matching accent color. "Auto" picks the right theme based on today's date.

Card Style

Changes the shape and look of the menu item boxes on every theme. Pick one to preview it right away.

Weather Effects

On regular days (no holiday theme), the site shows a thunderstorm look when it is storming in Ada. Auto checks the live weather. You can also preview it any time.

Holiday Closures (Auto)

Automatically shows "Closed" on the days below, every year, no matter what today's regular hours say. Turn off any holiday you want to stay open for.
Enable automatic holiday closures

Backup & Transfer

All edits save only to the browser/device you're using right now. Moving to a new browser, computer, or a live host? Export a backup here first, then import it there to bring everything over.

Chatbot Q&A

Add questions customers might ask. If what they type matches your keywords, the bot replies with your answer. Keywords are comma-separated words to watch for (e.g. "gluten, gluten free, celiac").
